name: Dreamcore
summary: Soft, hazy images of childhood rooms, pastel skies, old toys and stairways, with a faint glow and blurry text. It looks like a half-remembered dream and grew on Tumblr, Reddit and video sites.

philosophy.core_thesis: Show a memory as a dream does: soft, glowing and slightly wrong, with the details out of focus.
design_principles: Set the ground in pastel gradient from #FBE3F0 to #CFE3FF at 180°.
Apply a bloom of 12px to 24px on all light areas and lower the contrast by 15% to 25%.
Use one soft focal image (a room, a toy or a sky) at 50% to 70% of the frame.
Add one odd detail: a door in a field, a stair with no top or a repeated window.
Set text in a thin serif or a rounded sans at 14px to 28px, in 60% opacity white or lilac.
Add grain at 4% to 6% and a vignette of 15%.
Keep motion slow: loops of 8s to 20s with cross-fades of 1.2s.
anti_patterns: Hard black voids and red warning text

layout.grid_mechanics: One image fills the frame; text sits in a single block on a 4-column grid with 32px gutters.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 45% of the surface is soft sky or empty wall; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred focal image and a small text block at the lower third; the image may drift 12px off centre.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 24px radius or none; soft, feathered edges of 16px to 32px; circles for light spots.

font_pairings.note: A thin, soft serif display face with a round text face.
A high-contrast serif with a plain sans for text.
A handwriting face for notes, with a round sans text face.

hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: light (300) and regular (400).
Use italic for one line per frame.

color.palette_structure: Pastel pink, sky blue and lilac on a pale ground, with one warm light.
color.contrast_rules: Text in faded ink on dream haze holds at least 7:1; pale tints carry fields and glow, not text.
color.surface_treatment: Soft 2-stop gradients; bloom on lights; grain of 4% to 6%; low contrast.
color.light_and_shadow: A warm glow from one side; no hard shadow; shadows are tinted lilac at 20%.

materiality.surface_simulation: A faded photograph or a memory through frosted glass.
materiality.border_rules: No border; feathered edges of 16px to 32px; a 1px white line at 40% on panels.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Blur of 8px to 24px on background layers; panels have a 24px soft shadow in lilac at 20%.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons at 24px with round caps: stars, clouds, a door and a moon.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Pastel rooms, clouds, toys, stairways and old screens, with bloom and a soft colour grade.

motion.transition_physics: Slow cross-fades of 1.2s; a drift of 12px over 10s; light spots pulse at 6s per cycle.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the bloom by 8px and the text to full opacity; the active state fades the image by 20%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels gentle nostalgia and a soft, quiet unease, as after a dream.

use_cases: wellness and sleep apps with a soft tone
avoid_when: The page needs sharp, fast reading.
The product is technical or financial.
The brand needs a loud, high-energy voice.

modifiers.how: Lower the colour, add a black void and one line of red text.
Add glass bubbles, a sky photo and a green accent.
Add an aurora gradient, a blur of 40px and a thin sans display face.

pack.why: Thin, rounded line icons match the light, soft look of a dream image.

ground.why: Dreamcore sits in soft light with no hard edge, so the ground is a haze of overlapping soft gradients.
